recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Revisit only if future ballot feedback shows that the existing comparison note and shared formats page still lead readers to infer XML primacy.
issue_request: FHIR-18452 asked why XML examples appeared in the JSON section and was resolved as Published / Not Persuasive with Modification. The accepted clarification was to add a note near the JSON page content explaining that XML examples are included for easy comparison, not because XML has primacy or because JSON is expected to be derived from XML.
initial_application: Commit a7026edb074d5100e871d93a03aaa02231cb1218 applied FHIR-18452 for R5 by removing the old in-page comparison block, adding a note that XML examples are for comparison, and pointing readers to the shared formats comparison page. The combined branch had no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-18452 before this audit.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2021-10-04 corroborate the reopen and 14-0-4 Not Persuasive with Modification resolution. Later source history moved the note below an added additional-resources subsection, but it remains before the XML comparison examples; source/resource-formats.html also says XML follows JSON closely, avoiding any implication of XML primacy. The active hierarchy includes both json.html and resource-formats.html.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current source already satisfies the issue without adding redundant prose that could drift from the shared formats guidance.
